title: Invoicing resources now specify how they were generated
changed: InvoiceLineItem.invoice_item, proration, proration_details, subscription_item, type removed
reason: The recorded stripe/openapi contracts (2025-03-31.basil to 2026-09-30.endive) still declare line_item.subscription, so findRemovedProperties reports no removal.

parts.how: invoiceSubscriptionHelperEdit (stripe-subscription-periods.ts) rewrites traced reads to the generated getInvoiceSubscription helper, which reads either version; SDK reads keep the expand check (analyzer.ts propose), webhook reads do not.

changed: InvoiceLineItem.invoice_item, proration, proration_details, subscription_item, type removed
parts.how: findRemovedProperties (specifications.ts) reports the removed field and analyzeRepository (analyzer.ts) reports each traced read as a confirmed finding; STRIPE_MOVE_REVIEW (stripe-field-moves.ts) appends the named Stripe reason where it has one. No rule edits the read, so a deterministic patch leaves it unresolved and the AI patch path (run.ts aiFindings, ai-patches.ts proposeAiPatch) receives it.
